description: This PHP source file defines the MigrateMessageController class for handling migration message views and details in a Drupal module, including methods for overview display, detailed message listing, and filtering.

classes.name: MigrateMessageController
classes.description: Controller class providing methods to display migration messages overview and details, including filtering and pagination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting database connection, form builder, and migration plugin manager services.

methods.name: overview
methods.description: Displays an overview table of migrations with message counts, or a message if no migration message tables exist.

methods.name: details
methods.description: Displays detailed migration messages for a specific migration ID, with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: addFilterToQuery
methods.description: Adds session-based filters to the database query for migration messages.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the page title for the migration messages detail page.
